variants.title: Bragg curve of argon ions in lead (Bethe-Bloch)
variants.unknown: the Bragg curve and stopping depth of argon ions in lead
variants.note: Lead is less dense than gold, so the same ions go deeper in micrometres though the loss per gram is similar.

source.title: PDG 'Atomic and nuclear properties of materials' / ICRU Reports 37 and 49: Z/A, mean excitation energy I, density

variants.title: Bragg curve of krypton ions in gold (Bethe-Bloch)
variants.unknown: the Bragg curve and stopping depth of krypton ions in gold
variants.note: A heavier, more highly charged ion at the same speed per nucleon loses energy faster but also carries more of it: its range in micrometres comes out comparable. Kr-84 mass 83.9115 u.

source.title: PDG 'Atomic and nuclear properties of materials' / ICRU Reports 37 and 49: Z/A, mean excitation energy I, density
